name: teacher-assignment-to-grading
title: One class, from assignment to feedback
audience: Department chairs and ELA teachers evaluating YAWP! for a school or district
goal: Show that a teacher can see the whole class's writing in progress and give feedback without leaving the platform.

scenes.narration: This is a teacher's home screen in YAWP!, first thing Monday morning.
Every class the teacher runs, with live writing activity in each one.
Opening a class shows each student's current draft and where it stands.
Submitted work collects in one queue instead of a shared drive folder.
The teacher reads the essay, leaves inline comments, and scores against the rubric.

steps.text: Feedback stays attached to the exact sentence it belongs to.

scenes.narration: Same platform, same class, no exported files. That is the whole loop.
